title: sql_drills: MySQL 8.0.33 exact-output practice harness
objective: A CLI grades a SQL file against an original drill on a pinned mysql:8.0.33 container by exact judge-style output match, with 12 drills ordered by priority.
acceptance_criteria: start/stop/list/show/check work; check exits 0 pass, 1 mismatch (line diff), 2 SQL or engine error
Normaliser and diff are unit-tested without Docker; package coverage is 100% branch
Every drill's reference solution (tests/solutions only) reproduces expected.txt on live MySQL; those tests skip when the container is down
show and check never print reference SQL
out_of_scope: python_pkg/app_icons and AGENTS.md changes already in the working tree
verifier: python3 -m python_pkg.sql_drills start; ~/.claude/scripts/capped.sh python3 -m pytest -q -o addopts='--strict-markers --strict-config' python_pkg/sql_drills
